releases.notes:
Experimental local file management for Ember Link, for use with the Ember Bridge file-browser development build.

- Browse folders and paginated directory listings over paired local Wi-Fi.
- Create folders, rename/move files and folders, and delete files or empty folders.
- Reject stale listings, destination collisions, traversal and recursive deletion. Mutations are not retried automatically.
- Ignore hidden macOS metadata when checking actionable directory revisions.

Keep your embroidery machine idle and close its USB list during file operations. If attached to a computer, eject the drive before each read or change. Back up your designs; FAT metadata operations are not power-loss atomic.

Supporting tests passed on a second 120 MiB FAT32 card and Brother NQ1700E, including nested previews, all retained file hashes and a read-only FAT integrity check. The first qualification card developed corruption whose cause remains unresolved. This is an opt-in development build, not a stable or multi-day reliability certification.

Cloud file management is not included. Signed updates preserve settings; browser first-install/recovery erases Wi-Fi, local pairing and cloud identity but does not erase the microSD card. The existing enrollment functionality from 0.3.8-dev.1 remains included. Stable remains 0.3.7.
